comparison: Perfect agreement on claims C1-C4 regarding survey scope, dataset size, species identification, and classification scheme. Both evaluations find these claims SUPPORTED without concerns.
Perfect agreement on claims C43-C49 regarding comparative tube/vesicle morphology and pearling behavior across species. Both evaluations find these observations SUPPORTED.
Perfect agreement on claims C76-C77 regarding morphological diversity and functional implications. Both accept the observations and speculative interpretations as SUPPORTED.
Perfect agreement on claims C78-C79 regarding absence of basal machinery and connection to liquid-like assemblies. Both evaluations find these negative findings SUPPORTED.
Perfect agreement on claim C83 regarding correlation between cell membrane morphology and tube type in F. johnsoniae. Both find this quantitative observation SUPPORTED.

Strong agreement on claims C50-C54, C84 regarding nanopods in C. crescentus with detailed measurements. Both find these observations SUPPORTED. OpenEval also addresses C85 (generalization to S-layer bacteria), which peer review groups separately.

Strong agreement on claims C65-C75 regarding secretin-like complex in F. johnsoniae, including localization, structure, and comparative analysis. Both find these SUPPORTED. Peer review also includes functional speculation claims C89-C91, which OpenEval evaluates separately as UNCERTAIN.

Strong agreement on claims C32-C37 regarding H. pylori tubes and CORE-independence. Both find these SUPPORTED. Peer review also includes C80-C81 (comparative observations and CORE-independence), which OpenEval evaluates separately in R14.

Agreement on claims C55-C56 regarding T4aP complexes in M. xanthus OMEs. Both find these observations SUPPORTED. Peer review groups these with C5 (general protein complex identification), which OpenEval evaluates separately in R2.

Agreement on claims C40-C42 regarding vesicle chains in B. burgdorferi with detailed measurements. Both find these SUPPORTED. Peer review groups these with F. anhuiense observations (C38-C39), which OpenEval evaluates separately in R4.

Agreement on claims C59-C64 regarding crown-like structures across multiple species. Both find these observations SUPPORTED. Peer review also includes C6-C7 and C57-C58 (other novel protein complexes), which OpenEval evaluates separately.
Agreement on claims C38-C39 regarding F. anhuiense teardrop structures. Both find these morphological observations SUPPORTED. Peer review groups these with B. burgdorferi observations (C40-C42).

Agreement on claims C80-C81 regarding comparative observations and CORE-independence. Both find these SUPPORTED. Peer review groups these with H. pylori tube observations (C32-C37), which OpenEval evaluates separately in R3.

Partial overlap on claim C5 regarding protein complexes on MEs/MVs. Both find this general observation SUPPORTED. OpenEval groups C5 with detailed characterization (C6-C7), while peer review focuses on T4aP complexes (C55-C56).
Agreement on claims C57-C58 regarding novel protein complex on S. oneidensis vesicles. Both find these observations SUPPORTED. Peer review groups these with crown-like structures and other complexes.

Disagreement on evaluation type for claims C89-C91 regarding functional interpretations of secretin-like complex localization. OpenEval rates these as UNCERTAIN due to speculative nature, while peer review finds them SUPPORTED without concerns.
Agreement on claims C87-C88 regarding speculation about structural advantages and comparison to flagellar systems. Both find these speculative claims acceptable/SUPPORTED.
Agreement on claims C93-C94 regarding speculation about future research directions and functional studies. Both find these forward-looking statements SUPPORTED.
Agreement on claim C86 regarding speculation about nanopod functions. Both evaluations accept this speculation as SUPPORTED.
OpenEval evaluates claims C8-C31 (literature background and prior work) as SUPPORTED with appropriate citations. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these background claims.
